purpose: Bounded original-source evidence recovery and sensitivity, not permit or structural approval

source_pdf.authority: Reported observations only; native model not available

standards.title: Nepal NBC 105:2025, Seismic Design of Buildings in Nepal, second revision
standards.decision: Use for future physically authenticated seismic verification; source values alone insufficient

standards.title: IS 456:2000 Plain and Reinforced Concrete Code, amended
standards.decision: Use as design-check scope, not as evidence that source F3 passes

standards.title: Nepal governmental Structural Design Guidelines 2018, section 4.19 footings
standards.decision: Corroborates checking one-way shear at critical distance d from face; does not override source failure

evidence_recovery.candidate_original_model_rule: Require subject+story+grid+load pattern+mass-source identity checked from source owner; other-project named E2K files are not valid evidence
evidence_recovery.geotechnical_rule: Need project-specific soil bearing, settlement, groundwater and soil category; do not infer Vs30/NSPT from location
evidence_recovery.license_and_approval_rule: Owner approves methodology and study but only authenticated evidence and qualified independent design signoff can change physical acceptance

limitations: Source F3 explicitly NOT SAFE IN ONE WAY SHEAR; dimension variants are sensitivity inputs not approved selection
Observed 0.2 MPa allowable is rounded source text, not a verified Table 19 design shear capacity
Simplified pressure ignores own adjusted foundation selfweight, eccentricity, contact distribution and seismic actions
Does not calculate punching shear, bar development, flexure, bearing, settlement, shear reinforcement, full factored combination or soil capacity
No original EDB/E2K accepted and no drawing-verified F3 support path or site soil available
outcome_policy: Even an apparent one-way demand below rounded 0.2 MPa is NOT a design PASS; all alternative geometries remain NOT APPROVED
